title: notific.me Reply
description: Resposta assinada entregue ao sistema de origem (webhook ou retorno de ask()). Autocontida: traz as perguntas junto.

value.description: Valor estruturado (bool, string, array, number ou data ISO).

free_text.description: Free text from the human. UNTRUSTED input: validate it before acting on it or passing it to a model.

as_text.description: Natural-language summary, ready for an AI agent's context. Written in the asker's language: question-set.locale, else the Accept-Language of POST /v0/asks, else en (en, pt-BR and es are supported). Question texts, option labels and free text are quoted as they were written.

auth_method.description: How the human proved it was them. "delegated": answered (level 0-1) inside the company's own system, with a person token issued by the company's backend (the company authenticated the person, not notific.me).

group.description: The group through which the person could decide (#finance), when the question has a decision rule.

authority_level.description: The person's authority level in that group (manager).

decision.description: How the decision rule closed the question. With status answered the request was approved; with rejected, approval could no longer be reached (or someone vetoed).

eligible.description: People who could decide when it closed.

escalation_step.description: How many escalation steps had gone out.

votes.description: Every vote, in order, when the question has a decision rule. One vote per person.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the content shown to the human.

e_signature.description: Electronic signature the person applied, when the question set had require_signature. Covered by the reply signature like every other field.

method.description: typed: the name in a cursive style; drawn: drawn by finger or mouse.

style.description: Cursive style of a typed signature (great-vibes, dancing-script, sacramento, mr-dafoe).

signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the signature PNG bytes.

consent_version.description: Version of the consent text the person accepted when adopting.

adopted_at.description: When the person adopted this signature.
